title: Hair transplant in Albania | European Dental
description: Hair transplants in Albania with FUE and DHI techniques: digital planning, complementary treatments and post-operative care, from consultation to check-ups.

p: The rebirth of self-esteem. Every hair is a promise of confidence regained.
Hair loss can change the way you see yourself, but it does not have to change who you are.
In our specialist centres in Albania, hair transplant surgery is a medical art based on precision, technology and a human touch.
We work with internationally renowned surgeons, experts in the latest FUE and DHI techniques, to deliver natural, permanent and personalised results.
Our goal is not only to give you your hair back, but to restore your confidence, your freshness and the freedom to live without worries.
Today, the FUE technique is the most advanced standard in hair transplantation.
It is based on extracting individual follicular units (groups of 1-4 hairs) from the donor area, usually at the back of the head, and grafting them precisely into thinning or bald areas.
after: Every procedure is planned with digital simulation and dermoscopic analysis, to set the perfect density, direction and implant angle, creating a result that is aesthetically indistinguishable from natural hair.

p: DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) is the most modern evolution of FUE hair transplantation.
After extraction, the follicles are implanted directly, without first creating channels or incisions, using a special instrument called the Choi Implanter Pen.
items: Full control over the implant angle
after: It is the ideal solution for anyone who wants a natural, high-precision result with a shorter recovery time.

aftercare.h3: A successful transplant does not end in the operating theatre.
p: We take care of you before, during and after the procedure, with a medical and human approach that makes all the difference.
items: PRP (platelet-rich plasma) treatment to stimulate regrowth
after: The result is natural, gradual regrowth, with strong, healthy and permanent hair.

who.h3: A hair transplant is suitable for:
items: Men and women with androgenetic alopecia (hereditary baldness)
Patients who have already had a transplant and want to improve the result
after: Every case is unique: our team draws up a tailored treatment plan based on trichological analysis, lifestyle and aesthetic expectations.

items: Surgeons specialised in hair transplants with more than 10 years of experience
The latest FUE and DHI techniques
Complete support before and after the procedure
“All-Inclusive” packages with flight, hotel and a free consultation
why.h3: A new beginning, a new you
p: It is not just a hair transplant. It is a confidence transplant.
Start to like yourself again, to recognise yourself and to feel fully yourself.
after: Discover the solution tailored to you and look at yourself with pride again.
